# POST /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases

Create a new release or convert an existing tag to a release

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (write:repository scope) · **ID:** `ep-243`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `api.CreateReleaseOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `tag_name` | string | True | binding:Required |
| `tag_message` | string | False |  |
| `target_commitish` | string | False |  |
| `name` | string | False | truncated to 255 chars |
| `body` | string | False |  |
| `draft` | bool | False |  |
| `prerelease` | bool | False |  |

## Response

**201** — api.Release

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Release ID |
| `tag_name` | string | Git tag name |

- **404** — Target commit/branch not found
- **409** — Release already exists for tag or tag already has a release
- **422** — Repo is empty or tag name is protected

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Cannot create a release on an empty repository | validation | ctx.Repo.Repository.IsEmpty == true |
| If target is not provided, default branch is used as the release target | business_logic | len(form.Target) == 0 |
| If a tag record already exists, it is converted to a release (tag-to-release conversion) | business_logic | Existing release found AND rel.IsTag == true |
| Protected tag names prevent release creation and deletion | authorization | Tag matches protected tag pattern AND user not in allowlist |
| Git tag is only created when release is not a draft (published) | business_logic | !rel.IsDraft |
| Release title is truncated to 255 characters on create and update | validation | Always on insert/update |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Tag name already has a release | 409 | conflict | False |
| Tag is protected | 422 | validationError | False |
| Target commit/branch not found | 404 | target not found | False |

### Error Paths

- **Repo is empty** → ctx.APIError → 422
- **Release already exists** → ctx.APIError → 409
- **Tag name is protected** → ctx.APIError → 422
- **Target not found** → ctx.APIError → 404
- **Existing tag already has release** → ctx.APIError → 409
